# QUARANTINE NOTICES AND THE PEOPLE NOBODY ASKED [color=#5F6B70]Pinned thread. Transcriptions only. Copy the wording exactly, typos included. The typos tell you which desk wrote it.[/color]
### #1 ninth_shift (OP) // 83.01.22 - [bold]Solaris Gulch, on the Eta lab shutter:[/bold] [italic]Virology unit closed. Do not open storm shutters during clear weather.[/italic] Read it again. During clear weather. - [bold]Kutjevo, outer pump house:[/bold] [italic]Biohazard level three. Water from this station is safe to drink. Do not drink water from this station.[/italic] Both lines on one sheet, two different typefaces. - [bold]Shivas' Snowball (LV-343), ice core labs:[/bold] [italic]Pest control in progress. Security contractor has authority over research staff until further notice.[/italic] The spiders have been there since 2120. Why does pest control need authority now?
### #2 static_saint // 83.01.30 Every one of those closures had people walk out of it. Find me one interview. One. Manifests I have seen: - A Kutjevo filtration tech rotated out on a sealed shuttle and signed over to a Company medical ship before her contract ended. - Two Oxley's Butte dam hands listed as reassigned, then listed again on a Fiorina 161 transfer. Since when does a dam crew get transferred to a maximum security prison? - The Hope's Retreat passengers. A whole transport was told their destination was gone, and nobody in the press has asked them how they heard.
### #3 guest_1120 // 83.02.03 I live at Hope's Retreat. Nobody asks us anything. The old ones from the transport do not talk about the turnaround. One of them told me the news came from the crew, not the Company, and the crew were crying.
### #4 ninth_shift (OP) // 83.02.03 That is the first account of the announcement anyone has given us. Thank you. Write down the date you heard it and who said it, no names. Then log off.
